title: Reviewed open-access arbitrary-source research quality proof v0
problem: Blocked by ticket-421. Mock and crafted-note proofs do not establish that the quality-gated pipeline can analyze real scientific documents. A small licensed open-access proof must be run, manually reviewed, and reported with raw quality counts before retrieval work begins.
acceptance_criteria: A mock-safe proof harness can process a manifest of licensed open-access documents through eligibility, section parsing, candidate extraction, admission, review, corroboration, and graph reporting on temp or gitignored paths.

The operator-only live run uses at least three open-access scientific documents from at least two independent source families and records license, identifier, checksum, retrieval date, parser version, model identity, and prompt-contract version.

A human-reviewed private artifact records claim-level gold decisions, automated decisions, review decisions, precision, recall, F1, false-acceptance rate, per-slice counts, graph counts, and independent-source support.

GO requires contaminated-source false admissions 0, precision at least 0.90, recall at least 0.75, false-acceptance rate at most 0.05, complete claim provenance, and zero accepted bibliography/challenge/redirect/navigation claims.
The artifact reports raw numerators and denominators and returns PARTIAL or NO-GO when any threshold is missed; mock proof cannot satisfy the live reviewed gate.
Default pytest, golden tests, verify, and execute-safe do not use source network or live LLM.
Only after a reviewed GO artifact exists may ticket-423 change from blocked to ready; otherwise ticket-422 remains in_progress or blocked with the failure documented.
test_plan: With mock-only env: python -m pytest tests/golden -q
With mock-only env: python -m rge.cli verify --skip-site
Review-gated operator run only: execute the documented open-access quality proof with explicit source-network and live-LLM gates, then review the private artifact before setting GO
non_goals: Do not commit copyrighted full text without verified redistribution permission.
Do not accept mock results as live research proof.
Do not publish raw source text, review notes, prompts, local paths, or model responses.
Do not lower thresholds after observing results without a separate principal-audit ticket.
rollback_plan: Remove the proof harness and CLI surface while retaining private audit artifacts according to operator policy. Leave ticket-423 blocked if a reviewed GO was not achieved.
